tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Look up a website or URL (for example 'example-trade.com' or 'https://app.example-trade.com/login') in the official regulator warning lists compiled by Real Crypto Signals. tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Search the compiled regulator warning lists for a firm, brand or platform name (legal suffixes such as Ltd or LLC are ignored). Returns up to `limit` closest entries with the regulators that warned about them and the official notice URLs.

tools.name: latest_warnings
tools.description: The newest warnings added to the compiled lists, newest first. Optionally filter by regulator code (from list_sources) or by ISO country code of the regulator (for example GB, US, FR, ES, IT, SG).

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Which official warning lists are included, how many entries each one contributed, the official list URL and when it was last fetched.

tools.name: how_to_report
tools.description: Official places to report a crypto or investment scam in a given country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example US, GB, AU, CA, DE, FR, ES, IT, IN, SG). Returns agencies with their official URLs.
